blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: selection — Execution chooses a branch according to a condition.
iteration — A block repeats while a condition permits.
scope — Where a name can be accessed.
shadowing — A local declaration hides another accessible name.

blocks.title: Three control structures
blocks.text: Sequence runs in order; selection chooses a branch; iteration repeats instructions.

blocks.title: Where is a variable visible?
blocks.text: A local declaration belongs to its block or method; a class-level field can be accessed by relevant class methods.

blocks.title: Shadowing
blocks.text: A local variable with the same name as a field can hide that field inside the method; trace precisely which one is printed.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: Which x is in scope at the print statement?

blocks.title: Worked example · Model solution
blocks.text: The method-local x is 2 and shadows the field. The program prints 2.
